name: libBLS Heavy & QA Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - beta
      - stable
    paths:
      - 'CMakeLists.txt'
      - 'cmake/**'
      - 'bls/**'
      - 'dkg/**'
      - 'backends/**'
      - 'threshold_encryption/**'
      - 'tools/**'
      - 'test/**'
      - 'deps/**'
      - 'node/**'
      - 'scripts/**'
      - '.github/workflows/**'
      - '.github/actions/**'
  push:
    branches:
      - beta
      - stable
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_valgrind:
        description: 'Wrap unit tests with Valgrind (leave false for a fast native-only smoke run)'
        required: true
        default: true
        type: boolean

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  main_job:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS: >-
        ${{ (github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' || inputs.run_valgrind == true)
            && 'valgrind --leak-check=yes' || '' }}

    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Setup Linux & Dependencies
      uses: ./.github/actions/setup-linux-env
      with:
        extra-apt-packages: 'libc6-dbg'
    - name: Install Valgrind & Python tools
      run: |
        sudo snap install valgrind --classic
        python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install coincurve

    - name: Configure all
      run: |
        export CC=gcc-11
        export CXX=g++-11
        export TARGET=all
        mkdir -p build && cd build
        cmake ..
    
    - name: Build all
      run: |
        export CC=gcc-11
        export CXX=g++-11
        export TARGET=all
        cd build
        make -j$(nproc)

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        cp scripts/parameters.json build/
        cd build
        $NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS ./backends/backend_unit_test
        $NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS ./bls_unit_test
        $NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS ./dkg_unit_test
        $NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS ./utils_unit_test
        $NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS ./bls_test
        $NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS ./threshold_encryption/te_unit_test
        $NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS ./threshold_encryption/te_test
        $NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS ./threshold_encryption/te_encrypt_message
        $NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS ./dkg_attack

    - name: Run tools tests
      run: |
        ./scripts/run_tools_test.sh
  
  linux_build_with_emscripten:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18.x]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Setup Linux & Emscripten Dependencies
      uses: ./.github/actions/setup-linux-env
      with:
        extra-apt-packages: 'python3 python3-pip lcov'
        with-emscripten: 'true'
    - name: Install Python packages
      run: |
        sudo python3 -m pip install --ignore-installed --upgrade pip
        sudo python3 -m pip install pyopenssl ndg-httpsclient pyasn1 "requests[security]"
    - name: Install NODE JS
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
    - name: Build all
      run: |
        cd deps/emsdk
        ./emsdk install latest
        ./emsdk activate latest
        source ./emsdk_env.sh
        cd ../..
        mkdir -p build_em
        cd build_em
        export LIBRARIES_ROOT=../deps/deps_inst/wasm32-emscripten/lib
        emcmake cmake -DEMSCRIPTEN=ON -DBUILD_TESTS=OFF -DGMP_LIBRARY="$LIBRARIES_ROOT"/

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
